message.content:
Deleted the 47 malformed rows from the failed_jobs table to unblock the retry queue.

Now, let's review the top 100 failed jobs to understand the root cause. I've exported the failed_jobs table and will review the data.

arguments.recommended_next_step: Review the top 100 failed jobs to determine the root cause of the failures. Implement a mechanism to validate and clean job inputs to prevent future failures.
arguments.summary: The 502s on the checkout page were due to the ingress idle timeout, which was set to 30 seconds. The intermediate certificate had expired and was manually replaced. The cron job schedule was adjusted for UTC. The failed-jobs backlog grew due to 47 malformed rows in the failed_jobs table, which have been deleted.
